description: Two records - the two lowest base keys the fixture holds, 0500024453765740 then 0683586198171516 - written out literally at the 36 characters app/data/ASCII/cardxref.txt measures. The expected line order is record-1, record-1, record-2, record-2, and that ORDER is the whole point of the case: it is what proves the doubled DISPLAY GROUPS PER RECORD rather than alternating between them. :96 fires inside 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT, on the '00' arm of the READ that has just filled the record area with record 1, and :78 then fires for that same unchanged area in the mainline loop; only once both have fired does the PERFORM UNTIL at :74 iterate and fetch record 2. A translation that emitted record-1, record-2, record-1, record-2 would produce the same six lines and the same multiset of them, so nothing but the order distinguishes it - which is why two DISTINCT records are needed here and why a single-record case cannot make this statement at all. Six lines is the 2 + 2n shape at n = 2. Every expected value is DERIVED, never captured: read from app/cbl/CBACT03C.cbl and cross-checked against app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy for the 16 + 9 + 11 + FILLER PIC X(14) = 50 byte layout, app/jcl/READXREF.jcl for the STEP05 DD contract and its absent PARM, and app/data/ASCII/cardxref.txt for the rows themselves - no COBOL was executed to obtain any of it (AAP risk R-A).
